title: Optimize Input Lag (Mouse & Keyboard)
name: optimize-input-lag
description: Reduces HID queue latency, disables StickyKeys/FilterKeys hooks and sets high-precision timer resolution for mouse and keyboard.
deepDescription: Modifies HID class driver queue size (DataQueueSize = 16) in mouclass and kbdclass, disables Windows accessibility keyboard hooks (StickyKeys, FilterKeys, ToggleKeys) that inject input delays, and optimizes system timer resolution.
